subject: Staged onboarding committal and deliverable calendar — Polaris Insights
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@polarisinsights.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Draft timeline & first-pass deliverable roster for Polaris onboarding

Emily —

Great to meet last week. As promised, I pulled together a first-pass staged onboarding calendar that lines up the commercial milestones we discussed (SOW sign, secure provisioning, spike test, full traffic cutover) and the owners from both sides.

Attached is a lightweight spreadsheet with dates and responsibilities to help Polaris share internally. High level:
- Week 1 (Dec 13–17): Contract sign & procurement kick; provisioning request submitted
- Week 2–3 (Dec 20–Jan 2): Private VPC setup & security questionnaire exchange
- Week 4 (Jan 3–14): Integration spike (sample dataset, latency/cost baseline)
- Week 6 (Jan 24–28): Go/no-go + planned cutover week (soft launch)

Can you confirm whether the procurement window you mentioned (two-week review) starts Dec 13 or Dec 20? That shifts the rest of the dates. Also, does Polaris require any additional compliance artifacts beyond the SOC2 questionnaire we have on file?

Attachments: Polaris_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet — contains milestones, owners, and dependencies)

Next steps: if you confirm procurement window I’ll send a revised calendar and a short SOW draft we can start getting internal approvals on. Marissa (cc’d) will lead onboarding from Redwood’s side once we lock the schedule.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

[Attachment: Polaris_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (18KB)]

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@polarisinsights.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Turner <mike.turner@polarisinsights.com>, procurement@polarisinsights.com
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft timeline & first-pass deliverable roster for Polaris onboarding

Ben —

Thanks for this — the spreadsheet is helpful. Quick answers:
- Procurement review will start Dec 20 (our legal lead is out next week). So shift the sign date to Dec 22 to be conservative.
- We will need the SOC2 report and a short data-retention statement for our security team. I attached our standard procurement intake so you know the gating items.

Also looping in Mike who will own the technical intake on our side. Can Marissa confirm resource availability in late December and early January? Our platform team is taking a light sprint holiday Dec 24–Jan 2, so we’ll need Redwood-owned work to happen around that.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of Platform Integrations | Polaris Insights
emily.zhao@polarisinsights.com

[Forwarded attachment: Polaris_procurement_intake.pdf (procurement checklist)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@polarisinsights.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft timeline & first-pass deliverable roster for Polaris onboarding

Emily —

Appreciate the heads up about the Dec 24–Jan 2 holiday window. We can structure the onboarding so that Redwood-owned prep (provisioning, test dataset import, cross-account IAM) happens Dec 22–23 and then the integration spike runs Jan 4–12 when your engineers are back.

I’ll assign two onboarding engineers (lead: Priyom Das) to run the spike and shepherd the initial latency tests. Priyom, please see the procurement notes Emily attached and confirm any additional artifacts we’ll need to populate (SOC2 summary and a short data-retention blurb are on my radar).

Proposed updated milestones (high level):
- Dec 22: SOW sign & provisioning request submitted (Procurement start Dec 20)
- Dec 22–23: Redwood provisioning & config (private tenant, initial ACLs)
- Jan 4–12: Integration spike (sample dataset + baseline tests)
- Jan 18–21: Performance validation & A/B test prep
- Jan 24–28: Soft launch (limited traffic)

I’ll also drop a compact kickoff agenda and an owner RACI in Drive after we lock dates.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0125

[Attachment: kickoff-agenda.odt (4KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@polarisinsights.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-06T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft timeline & first-pass deliverable roster for Polaris onboarding

Emily / team —

Quick technical note from my side: to speed the spike we’ll need a small sample export from your production search index (anonymized). Sizewise: 50–200 GB is ideal but we can start smaller and iterate. Also confirm whether Polaris prefers SSH-based transfer to our ingestion endpoint or an S3 share.

On compliance: attached is a brief data-retention statement and pointer to our SOC2 summary (redacted). I also included a draft SOW snippet for the provisioning & spike scope so procurement can review scope vs cost.

Attachments: SOW_draft_POL-123.pdf; data_retention_summary.txt

If the procurement team needs a short MPO (minimal producer outline) I can produce that this week.

– Priyom
Priyom Das
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0179

[Attachment: SOW_draft_POL-123.pdf (27KB)]

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@polarisinsights.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@polarisinsights.com, Mike Turner <mike.turner@polarisinsights.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft timeline & first-pass deliverable roster for Polaris onboarding

Team —

Thanks — this reads well and aligns with our internal constraints. Confirming:
- Procurement will target SOW signature Dec 22 (legal will route this week)
- We will provide an anonymized 50GB export to the S3 share by Jan 4; Mike will own the upload
- Polaris confirms SOC2 and the short retention blurb from Redwood are acceptable for our security intake

We’re good to schedule a 45-minute kickoff the week of Jan 4 to walk the spike plan and validate roles. Please send a calendar invite (Jan 5/6 preferred). When you send the invite, please attach the latest MAP spreadsheet and the SOW draft so procurement has the context.

Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of Platform Integrations | Polaris Insights
emily.zhao@polarisinsights.com | +1 617-555-0103
